description: Source code for Windows UWP WASAPI audio device management, including device initialization, format support, and event handling.

classes.name: DefaultAudioRenderParams
classes.description: Manages cached parameters for default audio rendering device, including bitrate, channels, and passthrough support, with event handling for device changes.

methods.name: SetPassthroughWaveformat
methods.description: Configures a WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE structure for specific audio codecs (AC3 or EAC3).

methods.name: GetBitrate
methods.description: Returns cached bitrate of the default audio renderer.

methods.name: GetNumChannels
methods.description: Returns cached number of channels of the default audio renderer.

methods.name: GetPassthroughCodecSupport
methods.description: Checks support for specific passthrough codecs (AC3 or EAC3) in the default audio renderer.

methods.name: OnDefaultAudioRenderDeviceChanged
methods.description: Event handler triggered when the default audio render device changes; marks cache as dirty and clears MIME support cache.

methods.name: RefreshCachedParamsIfNeeded_Locked
methods.description: Refreshes cached device parameters if marked as dirty by querying the WASAPI device.

methods.name: WASAPIAudioDevice
methods.description: Class managing the initialization and activation of the WASAPI audio device, including format support and device event handling.

methods.name: InitializeAudioDevice
methods.description: Starts asynchronous activation of the default audio device.

methods.name: ActivateCompleted
methods.description: Callback for completing device activation, retrieves and configures the audio client, and checks format support.
